project: Last Copper - Verizon Smart Campus Innovation Challenge 2026-27 (Rutgers)

champion_thesis.name: Last Copper: Who Answers? (PROVE-first)
champion_thesis.one_liner: Verizon retires its Piscataway copper (notice 2026-03-A-NJ, on or after Dec 10 2026). Last Copper finds the elevator, refuge and fire-alarm lines still on that copper, moves each to a Verizon LTE line with certified partner hardware, then proves every path every night: tone out through the car speaker, tone back through the car mic, the location label checked, and a text mode for Deaf riders.

verbs.FIND: lifeline classifier that runs inside Verizon on its own CPNI (team never sees CPNI)
verbs.MOVE: certified POTS gateways on LTE-M/Cat-1 VoLTE (partner hardware, not our product)
verbs.PROVE: vendor-neutral supervisor: heartbeat, two-direction acoustic test, location-label check, HELP as data, Deaf text, triage + routing, hash-chained evidence

verified: Notice 2026-03-A-NJ dated 2026-09-08, implementation on or after 2026-12-10, 62 NJ wire centers incl. Piscataway PSWYNJPI (4 Skiles Ave); New Brunswick not listed (research/sources/)

kill_gates.A_oct31: Count of Rutgers life-safety lines on Verizon copper in a retiring wire center (>=25 Rutgers-first; 1-24 or unknown national-first with Rutgers PROVE pilot; 0 and no pilot -> HangUp)
kill_gates.B_bench: Does a hands-free elevator phone's echo canceller defeat a speaker-to-mic loopback (two-transducer design is default)
kill_gates.C_voice: VoLTE through a certified gateway completes calls to the console

runner_ups.name: HangUp: the network speaks up during the scam call
First Minute: every AED on campus, live to 911

retired_champion.name: Circadian: one campus forecast, three paychecks
retired_champion.why: Gen 3 red-team kill: ~$3 venue radio energy per game, ties Verizon AI on ordinary days, Wi-Fi does the sensing, NPV negative without pull-through, most crowded LLM space. Code kept as engineering bench.

evidence.baseline: traffic-history AI + learned margins + manual event mode; same planner, guard and margin learner as Circadian
retracted: HVAC comfort metric that could not fail

open_questions: Which wire center serves Busch/Livingston/SHI/RBHS Piscataway, and how many Rutgers life-safety lines are on Verizon copper?
Who answers Rutgers elevator HELP calls today, how fast, and do they know building and car?

Does Verizon already flag lifelines from line-type codes? Which team owns this inside Verizon?
